title: Music that keeps playing
caption: Play YouTube videos, whole YouTube playlists or audio streams in the background while you browse.

title: Whole playlists and your queue
caption: Jump to any video of a YouTube playlist and line up links and audio URLs in your own queue.

title: Sleep timer and shortcuts
caption: Fade out after 15 to 90 minutes or at the end of the track, and control playback from the keyboard.

title: Paste a link and press play
caption: A short hint on first run explains everything, and the popup can close while music plays.
